text:
carmen (partnerships): Quick kickoff: Arbor asked us to validate kernel-induced variance across lab and SI racks. Goal: quantify perf/W drift when kernel flags differ and produce a short internal doc + optional co-branded marketplace note if within 3% reproducibility.

vik (perf-eng): Outline: 1) baseline lab runs (rdx-7b & rdx-13b) with our default kernel; 2) controlled kernel-flag sweeps; 3) SI field runs with the same run_tags (SI provides per-minute CSVs). We'll compute perf/W time-series and a final steady-state window.

hana (eng-runtime): Telemetry parity is key. Lab will emit: pmbus.power_w, host.rapl_w, op.lat_ms_p50/p95, batch.p95, thermal.throttle_count, kernel.flags. SI field CSV must include timestamp, card_id, power_w, ambient_c, throttle_flag. I'm adding a compatibility map in the schema.

kevin @ArborCompute: We can ship probe kits to SI and lab. Note: some SI sites cannot provide raw PMBus logs; they can share per-minute aggregates. We'll include a small aggregator script for them. Kit ETA June 8.

raj (si-ops): We'll run field sweep on SI rack-21 June 15-16. We can do per-minute CSV drops to the shared S3 folder with restricted ACLs. Need exact run_tags to map to lab runs. Also request for a short installer checklist (BIOS, PSU model, thermal paste note).

lab-bot: Calendar invite created: "Hybrid kernel variance check (Arbor x Redwood)" Jun 14 14:00 PT (install), Jun 15-16 08:00 PT (runs).

carmen (partnerships): Action items: - hana: publish telemetry_schema_v5.json + compatibility map and SI aggregator script - vik: workload matrix (seq mix, QPS ramps, quant vs fp16) + perf/W calc recipe - raj: confirm SI CSV drop path and install window - kevin: probe kit ETA + wiring PDF - legal/marketing: hold on external messaging until numbers validated and legal approves.

vik (perf-eng): Workload notes: smoke runs: 20m at seq 256/768/1024, QPS ramp 10->200. Tuning runs: 4h kernel-flag sweeps with 30m steady-state captures. Perf/W calculation: instantaneous perf/W series + steady avg over last 10min; report raw W and normalized-to-TDP.

hana (eng-runtime): Example lab command for reproducibility:

```bash
rw-bench run --model rdx-13b --seq 1024 --qps 80 --dur 30m --telemetry telemetry_schema_v5.json --run_tag lab-seq1024-kf-default
```

kevin @ArborCompute: We'll provide a firmware note: disable power-smoothing for steady-state reads. Also recommend setting BIOS power profile to "performance". Wiring PDF in DM.

raj (si-ops): SI CSV schema confirmed: timestamp, card_id, power_w, temp_c, throttle_flag, run_tag. We'll push CSVs to s3://redwood-perf/interop/arbor/1744444444/si_csvs/ with ACL restricted to redwood_arbor_team.

carmen (partnerships): Timing: probe install Jun 14, smoke Jun 15, tuning Jun 16. Deliverables: - internal results doc (numbers + variance analysis) - artifact bundle (telemetry, git SHAs, BIOS snapshot, CSVs) in s3 - optional marketplace blurb draft if variance <=3% (legal signoff required).

vik (perf-eng): One ask: capture per-card thermal counters and PSU model strings; they help explain variance. I'll annotate analysis with ambient temp and throttle_reason.

hana (eng-runtime): Adding thermal counters and host psu.model field to schema. Will log runtime & kernel git SHAs in every run_tag and include a small converter to normalize SI per-minute CSV -> jsonl.

carmen (partnerships): Great. Please ack when tasks are created. We'll keep this thread for quick updates.

vik (perf-eng): ack, creating workload matrix PR now.

hana (eng-runtime): ack, opening PR with telemetry_schema_v5.json and SI aggregator.

kevin @ArborCompute: ack, kit ships Jun 6, arrives Jun 8.

raj (si-ops): ack, I'll confirm rack-21 window and post serial console details.

carmen (partnerships): Thanks all 64f Closing loop until install prep.
